en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear (comic, probably modern, no author I can name). 'На суво брич' and 'меша бак'рдан' are my reading; the second is probably a joking euphemism, the word бакардан is unknown to me and may be a dialect or invented word.

words_to_learn.en: high and dry (my reading of an idiom: shaved dry)
godmother fox (folk address for a sly fox)

lines.cyr: Петко љубел многу жени, останал без ич,
lines.lat: Petko ljubel mnogu ženi, ostanal bez ič,
lines.en: Petko loved many women, ended up with nothing,

lines.cyr: сите тие му тргнале на суво брич.
lines.lat: site tie mu trgnale na suvo brič.
lines.en: they all left him high and dry.

lines.cyr: На суво брич, Петко без ич,
lines.lat: Na suvo brič, Petko bez ič,
lines.en: High and dry, Petko with nothing,

lines.cyr: море какви бељи со Петкови жени.
lines.lat: more kakvi belji so Petkovi ženi.
lines.en: hey, what trouble with Petko's women.
Petko is very honest,
but a little easy.

lines.cyr: Првата му беше лична, личен јоргован.
lines.lat: Prvata mu beše lična, ličen jorgovan.
lines.en: The first one was pretty, pretty as a lilac.

lines.cyr: Со комшија ја фатија горе на таван.
lines.lat: So komšija ja fatija gore na tavan.
lines.en: They caught her with the neighbour up in the attic.
Up in the attic, stirring the bakardan.
Sweet bakardan, up in the attic.
Petko is very honest,
but a little easy.

lines.cyr: Втората му беше лична, лична како дрен.
lines.lat: Vtorata mu beše lična, lična kako dren.
lines.en: The second one was pretty, pretty as a dogwood.
They caught her on St George's Day.
On St George's Day, in broad daylight,

lines.cyr: море какви бељи со Петкови жени.
lines.lat: more kakvi belji so Petkovi ženi.
lines.en: hey, what trouble with Petko's women.
Petko is very honest,
but a little easy.

lines.cyr: Третата реши Петко лично да ја фати,
lines.lat: Tretata reši Petko lično da ja fati,
lines.en: The third, Petko decided to catch her himself,

lines.cyr: ама таа кума лиса, знае да му врати.
lines.lat: ama taa kuma lisa, znae da mu vrati.
lines.en: but she is a fox, godmother, she knows how to pay him back.
- Petko, give money, support the kids.

lines.cyr: Не се само мои, Петко, туку се и твои!
lines.lat: Ne se samo moi, Petko, tuku se i tvoi!
lines.en: They're not only mine, Petko, they're yours too!
Petko is very honest,
but a little easy.
